inputs.meanvarmarker_map: float32 [B,3,51,51]: channel 0 = (mean - mean_center)/mean_scale, 1 = (variance - var_center)/var_scale, 2 = one-hot agent cell

output: waypoints_normalized float32 [B,3,8]: the 8 control waypoints, xyz normalized to [-1,1]

world.marker: one cell at round((xy / xy_scale) * 50) clamped to 0..50; row = y, column = x

policy.use: ONE network call per plan (no sampling loop). meters = clamp(denormalize(output)): x, y = (v + 1) * xy_scale / 2 clamped to 0..xy_scale; z = (v + 1) * (z_max - z_min) / 2 + z_min clamped to z_min..z_max. See onnx_reference.py.
